note: v0.8.0 package-proof artifacts were built on GitHub Actions and independently verified against their SHA-256 sidecars. macOS is ad-hoc signed but not Developer ID signed or notarized, Windows is unsigned, and Linux is checksum-verified. These are not public-trust installers.

platforms.label: macOS
platforms.openNote: Not Developer ID signed or notarized. Verify SHA-256 first, then right-click the app -> Open -> Open to get past Gatekeeper the first time (or run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine on the .app).

platforms.label: Windows
platforms.openNote: The MSIX is unsigned, so Windows rejects a normal double-click install. Verify SHA-256 and download it only if you understand sideloading (Developer Mode + Add-AppxPackage). The former Pear identifier is not an alternative launch path.

platforms.label: Linux
platforms.openNote: After downloading: chmod +x the file and run it. The AppImage bundles the GTK4/libadwaita runtime pieces needed by the native shell on standard desktop distributions.

p2p.note: Legacy migration record only. It is not a Pear v3 launch or install path; use the native package for this device.

android.note: The v0.8.0 catalogue contract is merged and CI-verified. A production-signed APK and Google Play listing remain pending.

ios.note: The v0.8.0 catalogue contract is merged and CI-verified. iOS delivery still requires a production-signed App Store or TestFlight build and review.
